Android app · MIT licensed

MoeText 喵言喵

Automatic chat-text beautifier for Android

Built on Android's accessibility service, MoeText rewrites what you type in QQ and Discord using rules you define: swap words, add sentence endings and kaomoji, and switch between styles like catgirl or classical Chinese in one tap.

Download APK Android GitHub ↗（Opens in a new tab）

Requires Android 6.0 or later · Allow installs from unknown sources when installing

Features

  • Style packs

    Four built-in styles (catgirl, classical Chinese, emoji riddles and oracle) switch in one tap. Import and export your own as JSON.

  • Rule-chain engine

    Combine quick swaps, custom replacements, sentence endings, fixed suffixes and random kaomoji.

  • Two modes

    Rewrite after a pause or as you type, and send messages the way you always do.

  • Stays out of your way

    Continuous editing, cursor mapping and write-back retries keep the suffix at the end as you keep typing.

  • Material 3 design

    Follows system dark mode, with a live preview built in.

  • No data collection

    Network access is only used to check for updates. Nothing is collected or uploaded.

Getting started

  1. Install

    Download and install the APK.

  2. Enable accessibility

    On the Status tab, tap the button to open accessibility settings and allow MoeText.

  3. Set rules and chat

    Configure and save rules on the Rules tab, then go back to QQ or Discord and type as usual.

FAQ

Which apps are supported?

The chat input boxes in QQ and Discord.

What permissions does it need?

The accessibility service, to read and rewrite the chat input box, and network access, only to check for updates. The app collects and uploads nothing.

Is MoeText free?

Yes. It is open source under the MIT license on GitHub.

Before you use it

MoeText automatically rewrites the messages you send, which may violate Tencent QQ's terms of service and put your account at risk of restriction or suspension. Use it at your own discretion. MoeText is not affiliated with Tencent.
